----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Heard on IA No.18297/2023, which is 2nd application filed under Section 389 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 on behalf of appellant - Dheeraj who has been convicted by learned Special Judge, POCSO Act, 2012 District- Dewas (MP) in Special Case No.84/2019 vide judgment dated 03.04.2023 and sentenced as under:-
Section Act Imprisonment Fine if Imprisonment in deposited default of fine.
376 (3) IPS 20 years R.I. Rs.3000/- 1 year R.I. 3 r/w 4 POCSO Act,
2.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that prosecutrix has not supported the prosecution evidence in her statements and she has denied the suggestions given by the prosecution.

She has stated that she was not taken forcibly by anybody and she has never stated in her 161 statements and 164 statements as well as court statements that accused raped upon her and sexually harassed her.
Learned counsel further submits that charge-sheet was filed against the appellant only under Sections 363 and 366 of IPC and he was convicted only on the basis of FSL report.

He further submits that appellant was on bail during trial and he did not misuse the liberty granted to --2- him and final hearing of the appeal will take a long time, hence, it is prayed that the application for suspension of sentence be allowed and appellant be released on bail.
(3) Learned counsel for the respondent/State opposes the application and prays for its rejection.

sentences.text: (4) Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

(5) After hearing the learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of the record, it is found that charge-sheet has been filed against the appellant under Sections 363 and 366 of IPC and also considering the evidence of PW- 1 and para Nos.10, 11 and 12 of cross objection, this Court is of the opinion that the appellant deserves to be released on bail.

(6) It is directed that if the appellant - Dheeraj deposits the entire fine amount, if not already deposited, and furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/-(Rupees One Lac) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial court on 6th August, 2024 and on such subsequent dates as may be fixed in this regard,
sentence of imprisonment awarded to him shall remain suspended till further orders and he shall be released on bail.
C.C. as per rules.
 (S. A. DHARMADHIKARI ) (
 JUDGE   N.R.
